evidence.title: GitHub - jeremy-prt/bloub: SVG recreation of the x.ai bot avatar. One shape morphing through 14 states, measured off the reference video frame by frame. · GitHub

name: bloub
summary: Animated SVG avatar that morphs between 14 states, with shape, colour and expression controls and SVG, PNG, GIF and MP4 export.
description: A Vue app that recreates the x.ai bot avatar as one filled black shape morphing between 14 states plus two independently morphing eyes, with no animation library. It offers a customiser (8 body shapes, 12 colours, 16 rest expressions), a small timeline editor for arranging states, and exports: the avatar as SVG, PNG or animated GIF, and a whole timeline as GIF or MP4. The shapes were measured frame by frame from the reference video.
contains: one black shape morphing between 14 states, two eyes morphing independently
customiser: 8 body shapes, 12 colours, 16 rest expressions
timeline editor: arrange states and set hold durations
exports: SVG, PNG, animated GIF and GIF/MP4 timelines
no animation library — pure SVG with a time-sampled engine
measured frame by frame from the reference video
